protocol.split: chronological 70 / 10 / 20; a CONTIGUOUS block of consecutive windows from the TEST region, so onset transitions are real
protocol.congestion_threshold: 0.6 x per-node free-flow (85th percentile of that node's TRAIN-split observed values)
protocol.missing: values of 0.0 are sensor outages and are excluded from every metric
protocol.isolation: each model family runs in its own process: torch and the tree libraries deadlock when they share an interpreter
protocol.not_compared_with: OpenCity — it is scored on a 288-step horizon under its authors' split; mixing protocols would be meaningless
